title: Zephyr: Trickle timer implementation
description: Trickle timer per RFC 6206. AC: Implementation matches RFC 6206 algorithm.
notes: Implemented and validated RFC 6206/LICHEN Trickle timer. Added canonical profile constants (Imin=4000ms, Imax=8 doublings/1024000ms, k=10), fail-closed init validation (-EINVAL/-ERANGE), active-state transition checks, deterministic range-checked injected random offsets, capped doubling, saturating consistency counter, authorized reset with fresh sample per canonical packets-timing repeated-inconsistency vectors, and modular uint32 deadlines plus wrap-safe due checks. Validation: cmake build succeeded; CTest 1/1 passed with UBSan enabled; focused executable passed 27/27; cppcheck warning/style/performance/portability passed; git diff --check passed. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/trickle.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_trickle.h, lichen/tests/trickle/main.c, lichen/tests/trickle/CMakeLists.txt.
close_reason: Completed RFC 6206 Trickle implementation and focused boundary validation
